notes.title: TRIBAL the 12 Gates Release Date
notes.notes:
It's official. TRIBAL the 12 Gates will release exclusively on STEAM Thursday April 14, 2022 at 12:01 AM.

A huge thanks and shoutout to all of our friends, supporters, and the STEAM community. 

Conquer. Be Conquered. Repeat.

notes.title: TRIBAL Playing with Friends
notes.notes:
[h2]TRIBAL "The 12 Gates" Video Tutorial Series[/h2]

TRIBAL Playing with Friends
If you are playing with a group of friends or online with the larger community, you will probably want to cooperate with other tribes. This short video shows you how to mark other Tribes as friendly, so all of your Raid Teams cooperate.

notes.title: TRIBAL the 12 Gates Patch 1.0.84.3
notes.notes:
TRIBAL the 12 Gates
[b]Patch 1.0.84.3[/b]

This patch contains incremental fixes and enhancements for TRIBAL the 12 Gates.

[b]Platforms Effected[/b]:
TRIBAL Client for PC
TRIBAL Server for PC
TRIBAL Client for OSX
TRIBAL Server for OSX


[b]Enhancements[/b]:
Added Friendly Target lines for Cast and Attack
Created Attack Priority System for Raid Parties, Dark Lords, and Bosses
Enchanters now wait for enemies to apply buffs
Healers now heal only when target threshold is below HP/MP to give

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
Corrected teleporter behavior to spawn Evolved Bosses when teleporting everyone
Fixed bug that displayed enchant times incorrectly on Player Detail HUD
Fixed big that removed buffs prior to expiration time

notes.title: TRIBAL the 12 Gates Patch 1.0.81
notes.notes:
TRIBAL the 12 Gates 
[b]Patch 1.0.81[/b]

This patch contains incremental fixes and enhancements for TRIBAL the 12 Gates.

[b]Platforms Effected[/b]:
[list]
[*] TRIBAL Client for PC
[*] TRIBAL Server for PC
[*] TRIBAL Client for OSX
[*] TRIBAL Server for OSX
[/list]

[b]Enhancements[/b]:
[list]
[*] Increase starting resources to 20K (ease early game economy development)	
[*] Dark Lords now spawn within one minute on all maps (improves local server new game pace)
[*] Technology Tree now updates continually (allows viewing and live update of upgrades)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug that caused regression of secondary stats during hp/mp regen to 1
[*] Fixed bug that prevented setting Build Priority to Wood/Food
[/list]

notes.title: Gold Rush
notes.notes:
[h2]TRIBAL "The 12 Gates" Video Tutorial Series[/h2]
https://youtu.be/AmHZe7LgQ1k

This is part of the Video Tutorial Series for TRIBAL “The 12 Gates”.

Building an early to mid-game economy is critical. Find out more about leveraging your Tribe Chieftain's ability to teach other Tribe Members upgrades from the production branch of your Tech Tree and the early resource upgrades that will quickly accelerate resource generation.


A huge thanks to Arik from the Tribal community for taking the time and effort to publish a “how to” series – WE LOVE YOU ARIK!

Stay tuned, more tutorials are on the way.

notes.title: Game Play Overview
notes.notes:
[h2]TRIBAL "The 12 Gates" Video Tutorial Series[/h2]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gpcHarLmCeU

This is the first in a series of Video Tutorials for TRIBAL “The 12 Gates”. 

If you are new to the game, or just curious what the game is all about, this tutorial walkthrough will provide a foundation for “How to Play”. If you only watch one video about how to get started – this is a “can’t miss”. 

This tutorial is the longest in the series, at around 17 minutes, but gives a complete overview of the gameplay mechanics. If you are thinking about getting the game – you can also get a general idea of the game composition and flow by watching. 

A [b]huge thanks to Arik[/b] from the Tribal community for taking the time and effort to publish a “how to” series –  WE LOVE YOU ARIK!

Stay tuned, more tutorials are on the way.

notes.title: TRIBAL "The 12 Gates" Official Release
notes.notes:
[h3]Our team at tribal.games is proud to announce the general release date for Tribal “The Twelve Gates”, a single or multi-player persistent RTS.
[/h3]

Crazy how time moves like a freight train. We would like to extend a [b]heart-felt “thanks”[/b] to the community testers that remained focused and dedicated from October of 2021 to current state. We couldn’t have done it without your feedback, support, and encouragement. 

[h3]Exclusively on STEAM Games![/h3]
[h1]April 14, 2022[/h1]
